title: AG Advokat and Vesence
summary: AG Advokat, one of Sweden's leading law firms in real estate, construction and the industrial sector, on how its lawyers use Vesence: apps built around a case, the whole case in Word and Excel, and more time for advice.
body_markdown:
Founded in 1983, AG Advokat is one of Sweden’s leading business law firms specialising in real estate, construction and the industrial sector. Based in Stockholm, the firm advises Swedish and international clients on complex matters, combining legal expertise, commercial insight and extensive industry experience.


For the firm, AI is part of how it keeps developing: not a goal in itself, but a tool for working smarter without giving up quality or judgment.
